actions.name: Fast Blade
description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 220.

actions.name: Fight or Flight
description: Additional Effect: Grants Goring Blade Ready

actions.name: Riot Blade
description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 170.

actions.name: Total Eclipse
description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 120 to all nearby enemies.

actions.name: Shield Bash
description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 100.

actions.name: Release Iron Will
description: Cancels the effect of Iron Will.

actions.name: Shield Lob
description: Delivers a ranged attack with a potency of 100.

actions.name: Rage of Halone
description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 100.

actions.name: Spirits Within
description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 270.

actions.name: Prominence
description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 100 to all nearby enemies.
Divine Might Effect: Allows next Holy Spirit or Holy Circle to be cast immediately with increased potency

actions.name: Cover
description: Take all damage intended for another party member as long as said member remains within 20 yalms.
Does not activate with certain attacks.

actions.name: Circle of Scorn
description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 140 to all nearby enemies.

actions.name: Hallowed Ground
description: Renders you impervious to most attacks.

actions.name: Goring Blade
description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 700.
Can only be executed while under the effect of Goring Blade Ready.

actions.name: Divine Veil
description: Creates a barrier around self and all party members near you that absorbs damage equivalent to 10% of your maximum HP.

actions.name: Clemency
description: Additional Effect: Restores to self 50% of HP restored to target if target is a party member

actions.name: Royal Authority
description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 200.
Divine Might Effect: Allows next Holy Spirit or Holy Circle to be cast immediately with increased potency

actions.name: Intervention
description: Reduces target party member's damage taken by 10%.
Additional Effect: Increases damage reduction by an additional 10% if Rampart or Guardian are active
Additional Effect: Grants Knight's Resolve to target
Knight's Resolve Effect: Reduces damage taken by 10%
Additional Effect: Grants Knight's Benediction to target
Knight's Benediction Effect: Gradually restores HP

actions.name: Holy Spirit
description: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 400.
The effect of Divine Might will be prioritized over Requiescat when under the effect of both.

actions.name: Intervene
description: Rushes target and delivers an attack with a potency of 150.

actions.name: Requiescat
description: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 320.
Additional Effect: Grants 4 stacks of Requiescat
Requiescat Effect: Increases the potency of Holy Spirit, Holy Circle, and all Confiteor combo actions, and spells will require no cast time

actions.name: Passage of Arms
description: Increases block rate to 100% and creates a designated area in a cone behind you in which party members will only suffer 85% of all damage inflicted.
Effect ends upon using another action or moving (including facing a different direction).

actions.name: Holy Circle
description: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 100 to all nearby enemies.
The effect of Divine Might will be prioritized over Requiescat when under the effect of both.

actions.name: Atonement
description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 460.
Can only be executed while under the effect of Atonement Ready.

actions.name: Supplication
description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 500.
Can only be executed while under the effect of Supplication Ready.
※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar.
※Atonement changes to Supplication when requirements for execution are met.

actions.name: Sepulchre
description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 540.
Can only be executed while under the effect of Sepulchre Ready.
※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar.
※Supplication changes to Sepulchre when requirements for execution are met.

actions.name: Confiteor
description: Deals unaspected damage to target and all enemies nearby it with a potency of 500 for the first enemy, and 60% less for all remaining enemies.
Can only be executed while under the effect of Confiteor Ready. Effect fades upon execution.

actions.name: Holy Sheltron
description: Knight's Resolve Effect: Reduces damage taken by 15%
Knight's Benediction Effect: Gradually restores HP

actions.name: Expiacion
description: Delivers an attack to target and all enemies nearby it with a potency of 450 for the first enemy, and 60% less for all remaining enemies.

actions.name: Blade of Faith
description: Deals unaspected damage to target and all enemies nearby it with a potency of 260 for the first enemy, and 60% less for all remaining enemies.
※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar.
※Confiteor changes to Blade of Faith when requirements for execution are met.

actions.name: Blade of Truth
description: Deals unaspected damage to target and all enemies nearby it with a potency of 380 for the first enemy, and 60% less for all remaining enemies.
※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar.
※Blade of Faith changes to Blade of Truth when requirements for execution are met.

actions.name: Blade of Valor
description: Deals unaspected damage to target and all enemies nearby it with a potency of 500 for the first enemy, and 60% less for all remaining enemies.
Additional Effect: Grants Blade of Honor Ready
※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar.
※Blade of Truth changes to Blade of Valor when requirements for execution are met.

actions.name: Guardian
description: Additional Effect: Erects a magicked barrier which nullifies damage equivalent to a heal of 1,000 potency

actions.name: Imperator
description: Deals unaspected damage to target and all enemies nearby it with a potency of 580 for the first enemy, and 60% less for all remaining enemies.
Additional Effect: Grants 4 stacks of Requiescat
Requiescat Effect: Increases the potency of Holy Spirit, Holy Circle, and all Confiteor combo actions, and spells will require no cast time

actions.name: Blade of Honor
description: Deals unaspected damage to target and all enemies nearby it with a potency of 1,000 for the first enemy, and 60% less for all remaining enemies.
Can only be executed while under the effect of Blade of Honor Ready.
※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar.
※Imperator changes to Blade of Honor when requirements for execution are met.

traits.name: Tank Mastery
description: Reduces damage taken by 20%. Furthermore, grants a bonus to maximum HP based on your vitality attribute, and a bonus to damage dealt based on your strength attribute.

traits.name: Oath Mastery
description: Increases Oath Gauge by 5 each time an auto-attack lands.

traits.name: Enhanced Fight or Flight
description: Grants Goring Blade Ready upon executing Fight or Flight.

traits.name: Chivalry
description: Restores MP when using Riot Blade or Spirits Within.

traits.name: Rage of Halone Mastery
description: Upgrades Rage of Halone to Royal Authority.

traits.name: Divine Magic Mastery
description: Halves MP cost for all spells while preventing casting interruptions via damage taken. Grants the following effects after successfully completing a combo with Royal Authority:
Divine Might Effect: Allows next Holy Spirit or Holy Circle to be cast immediately with increased potency

traits.name: Enhanced Prominence
description: Grants the following effects after successfully completing a combo with Prominence:
Divine Might Effect: Allows next Holy Spirit or Holy Circle to be cast immediately with increased potency

traits.name: Enhanced Sheltron
description: Extends the duration of Sheltron to 6 seconds.

traits.name: Sword Oath
description: Grants Atonement Ready after successfully completing a combo with Royal Authority.

traits.name: Enhanced Requiescat
description: Grants the effect of Confiteor Ready upon landing Requiescat.

traits.name: Enhanced Intervention
description: Extends the duration of Intervention to 8 seconds.
Grants Knight's Resolve to target, reducing damage taken by 10%.
Grants Knight's Benediction to target, gradually restoring HP over time.

traits.name: Divine Magic Mastery II
description: Adds a healing effect to Holy Spirit, Holy Circle, and Confiteor.

traits.name: Melee Mastery
description: Increases the potency of Fast Blade to 200, Riot Blade to 140, Royal Authority to 140, Holy Spirit to 350, Atonement to 400, Supplication to 420, and Sepulchre to 440.

traits.name: Enhanced Divine Veil
description: Adds a healing effect to Divine Veil.

traits.name: Melee Mastery II
description: Increases the potency of Fast Blade to 220, Riot Blade to 170, Royal Authority to 200, Holy Spirit to 400, Atonement to 460, Supplication to 500, Sepulchre to 540, Confiteor to 500, Blade of Faith to 260, Blade of Truth to 380, and Blade of Valor to 500.

traits.name: Enhanced Blade of Valor
description: Grants the effect of Blade of Honor Ready upon landing Blade of Valor.
Imperator changes to Blade of Honor while under the effect of Blade of Honor Ready.
